rows.grounds: compound denoting the genuine nature or essence of scripture
instrumental agent; śakti as one's inherent power
past passive participle indicating prompting or arousal

items.question: By what power is the true essence of scripture impelled in the mouth?
premises: The true essence of scripture arises in the mouth.
This arising is described as impelled or prompted.
The impelling force is one's own inherent power.
items.inference: The authentic expression of scriptural essence in speech is driven by one's own power rather than by external instruction alone.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of vadane as locus of manifestation or utterance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: O beloved, the true essence of scripture is impelled in the mouth by one's own power.
